dates.name: Thanksgiving Point Tulip Festival — Ashton Gardens
dates.desc: Peak tulip season! Over 1 million flowers across 50 acres including 400,000 tulips in 175+ varieties. Live music on weekends, vendors, and food trucks. Stroll through stunning gardens, capture photos in bloom paradise, or take a DSLR photography class during golden hour.
dates.where: Thanksgiving Point — Ashton Gardens, 3900 N. Garden Drive, Lehi, UT 84048

dates.name: Museum of Ancient Life at Thanksgiving Point — Dinosaurs & Fossils
dates.desc: World-class paleontology museum with 60,000+ bones and fossils, including the famous Allosaurus skeleton and Egyptian mummy. Perfect pairing with the Tulip Festival (same location). Spend morning in gardens, afternoon exploring dinosaurs—a complete, educational date.
dates.where: Thanksgiving Point — 3900 N. Garden Drive, Lehi, UT 84048

dates.name: Anchor Dance Studio Spring Recital — Legends Mixtape
dates.desc: Spring 2026 dance recital showcasing vibrant performances from talented young dancers. Family-friendly event with energy, creativity, and live music. A fun, festive evening supporting the arts community. Great for a lively date night out.
dates.where: Anchor Dance Studio — Salt Lake City area (check website for specific venue)

dates.name: Utah Symphony — The Film Music of Bernard Herrmann
dates.desc: Experience iconic film scores performed live by the Utah Symphony. Bernard Herrmann's masterworks from Hitchcock thrillers create a dramatic, immersive evening. Abravanel Hall's acoustics amplify every dramatic swell. A sophisticated, romantic date for arts lovers.
dates.where: Abravanel Hall — 123 W South Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Dinner at Rime at Deer Valley — Alpine Fine Dining
dates.desc: Expertly staffed upscale steakhouse with exceptional steaks, fresh seafood, and a world-class wine list. Overseen by exec chef Matthew Harris. Mountain views and intimate ambiance make this perfect for a special, romantic evening. Sublime preparation and service.
dates.where: Rime at Deer Valley — Deer Valley Resort, Park City, UT (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: Blippi: Be Like Blippi — Eccles Theater
dates.desc: Live stage show featuring beloved children's entertainer Blippi in an interactive, energetic performance. Great if you want a fun, lighthearted Friday evening with live music and comedy. Entertainment, laughter, and pure joy.
dates.where: Eccles Theater — 131 S Main St, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: TopGolf at Vineyard — Gamified Golf + Dinner
dates.desc: Friendly competition in private bays with automatic scoring, food, and full bar. Zero golf skill required—just fun, laughter, and playful competition. Great Friday night vibe with a relaxed, upbeat energy. Play games, grab dinner, enjoy each other's company.
dates.where: TopGolf — 484 N Entertainment Way, Vineyard, UT 84059 (30 min south of SLC)

dates.name: Salt Lake Bees vs. Sacramento River Cats — Minor League Baseball
dates.desc: Casual, laid-back minor league baseball atmosphere. Bees play at the beautiful Ballpark at America First Square in South Jordan. Great for conversations between innings, stadium food, and enjoying spring baseball under the sun. Perfect Saturday afternoon date.
dates.where: The Ballpark at America First Square — South Jordan, UT (south of SLC)

dates.name: Stewart Falls Hike — 200-Foot Tiered Waterfall
dates.desc: Moderate 3.5-mile hike to an incredible 200-foot tiered waterfall cascading down Mt. Timpanogos. Perfect spring timing with robust water flow from snowmelt. Clear water, Douglas fir and blue spruce forests, and stunning alpine scenery. One of Utah's most photogenic waterfalls.
dates.where: Stewart Falls Trailhead — Aspen Grove, Provo Canyon, UT (45 min from SLC)

dates.name: Final Night of Phantom of the Opera + Celebration Dinner
dates.desc: Catch the final performance of the spectacular Cameron Mackintosh production. Then celebrate with a special dinner at Log Haven or Rouser—perfect for toasting the unforgettable theatrical experience you just shared. Make it a night to remember.
dates.where: Eccles Theater — 131 S Main St, Salt Lake City, UT 84101 (show); Log Haven or Rouser for dinner

dates.name: Museum of Ancient Life + Red Butte Garden Stroll
dates.desc: Explore 60,000+ fossils and skeletons at the paleontology museum. Then walk through the adjacent Red Butte Garden with spring wildflowers and botanical beauty. Educational, scenic, and romantic—a full afternoon of discovery and nature.
dates.where: Natural History Museum of Utah — 301 S 1300 E, Salt Lake City, UT 84112
dates.reservation: none (museum tickets at door or online)

dates.name: Cross E Ranch Spring Festival — Farm Fun & Animals
dates.desc: Vibrant spring festival running through May 9. Enjoy baby animals, jumping pillows, obstacle courses, duck races, ziplines, big slides, and more. Food trucks available. Great for a fun, playful date with lots of laughter and outdoor activities. Runs Monday-Thursday 4-8 PM, Friday 4-9 PM, Saturday 10 AM-9 PM.
dates.where: Cross E Ranch — 3500 N. 2200 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84116

dates.name: Utah Utes Baseball — vs. Utah Valley
dates.desc: College baseball under spring lights. Relaxed, fun atmosphere perfect for conversation between innings. Excellent ballpark food, easy parking, and beautiful evening weather. Great for casual date night with sports.
dates.where: America First Ballpark — 1300 S 1300 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84104

dates.name: Dinner at Log Haven — Millcreek Canyon Mountain Dining
dates.desc: Scenic location four miles up Millcreek Canyon with Chef Dave Jones' menu embracing Southwestern spice and rustic mountain setting. Beautiful views, excellent service, and seasonal ingredients. A romantic, upscale dining experience just minutes from downtown SLC.
dates.where: Log Haven Restaurant — Millcreek Canyon, Salt Lake City, UT 84124 (4 miles up Millcreek Canyon Rd)

dates.name: Utah Utes Baseball — vs. TCU (Big 12 Conference)
dates.desc: Important Big 12 conference matchup! Spring college baseball with competitive play, great atmosphere, and ballpark energy. Perfect for sports fans. Multiple games over the weekend (May 8-10), so catch one or several.
dates.where: America First Ballpark — 1300 S 1300 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84104

dates.name: Monster Energy AMA Supercross Championship — Salt Lake City
dates.desc: Thrilling motocross racing! High-speed action, incredible stunts, and electric crowd energy. Similar adrenaline to the hockey games you loved. Qualifying and FanFest start at 10 AM; main event at 5 PM. Loud, exciting, unforgettable.
dates.duration: 4 - 5 hrs (full day) or 2 - 2.5 hrs (main event only)
dates.where: Rice-Eccles Stadium — 451 S 1400 E, Salt Lake City, UT 84112

dates.name: La Traviata — Janet Quinney Lawson Capitol Theatre
dates.desc: Classic opera performance bringing passionate romance and drama to life. Beautiful sets, live orchestra, and world-class vocals. Perfect for arts lovers like you (5-star Phantom fan). An elegant, culturally enriching evening.
dates.where: Janet Quinney Lawson Capitol Theatre — 50 W 200 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Emerald Pools Trail — Zion National Park Spring Waterfalls
dates.desc: Spring brings the most dramatic water flow to Zion's waterfalls! Hike to the Lower, Middle, and Upper Emerald Pools with pristine water cascading against red rock walls. Easy to moderate trails. April-May is ideal for maximum waterfall flow. Stunning photography and profound natural beauty.
dates.where: Zion National Park — Springdale, UT (2.5 hrs from SLC)

dates.name: Antelope Island State Park — Bison, Wildlife & Sunset
dates.desc: Peak spring season for wildflowers and bison herds. Drive or hike the island to spot pronghorn, bighorn sheep, and native bison against stunning Great Salt Lake backdrops. Sunset views are spectacular. Bring a picnic and stay for golden hour.
dates.where: Antelope Island State Park — 4528 W 1700 S, Syracuse, UT 84075 (40 min north)

dates.name: Bridal Veil Falls — Easy Provo Canyon Hike
dates.desc: Short, easy 0.8-mile hike to a stunning 607-foot waterfall in Provo Canyon. Perfect for spring runoff views. Accessible for all fitness levels. Stunning photo opportunities and refreshing mist from the falls. Great quick outing with big impact.
dates.where: Bridal Veil Falls Trailhead — Provo Canyon, UT (50 min from SLC)

dates.name: Snowbird Aerial Tram & Summit Restaurant — Alpine Evening
dates.desc: Ride the 2,000-foot tram to Hidden Peak (11,000 ft) with 360-degree views of the Wasatch Mountains. Stop at the summit restaurant for drinks or dinner while watching sunset over Utah Valley. Accessible, romantic, and breathtaking.
dates.where: Snowbird Resort — 9385 E Snowbird Tram Rd, Snowbird, UT 84092

dates.name: Kayaking or SUP at Bear Lake — Alpine Water Adventure
dates.desc: Pristine alpine lake surrounded by mountains. Crystal-clear turquoise water and peaceful paddle routes. You love lake dates—this captures that magic with an elevated alpine setting. Rent kayaks or try paddleboarding. Morning calm or sunset romance.
dates.where: Bear Lake State Park — Garden City, UT (1.5 hrs north)

dates.name: Dinner at Handle — Park City Farm-to-Table
dates.desc: Intimate farm-to-table restaurant with Chef Dave Jones' celebrated small plates and entrees. Think sweet chili-glazed cauliflower, fresh fish, and heritage meats. Excellent wine list and cozy atmosphere. Sophisticated yet approachable.
dates.where: Handle — Park City, UT (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: Dinner at Courchevel Bistro — French Elegance
dates.desc: Authentic French bistro perfect for date nights. Signature baked brie appetizer, venison loin medallion, and steak frites prepared with classic French technique. Romantic ambiance, excellent service, wine pairings.
dates.where: Courchevel Bistro — Park City, UT (30 min from SLC)

dates.name: Dinner at Rouser at Asher Adams — Urban Sophistication
dates.desc: Contemporary American cuisine with fresh, seasonal ingredients. Chef-curated tasting menus available. Sophisticated urban setting in downtown SLC with excellent cocktails and wine. Perfect for special occasions and memorable meals.
dates.where: Rouser at Asher Adams — Downtown Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Dinner at APEX — Montage Deer Valley
dates.desc: Elegant fine dining at Montage Deer Valley with sweeping mountain views. Exceptional steaks, fresh seafood, and impeccable service. Wine pairings curated by experts. Luxurious, romantic, and unforgettable.
dates.where: APEX at Montage Deer Valley — Deer Valley, Park City, UT (30 min)

dates.name: Rock Climbing at The Front Climbing Club
dates.desc: State-of-the-art gym with bouldering, rope climbing, and varied walls for all skill levels. Instructors provide guidance for beginners. Challenging, fun, and great for couples seeking active experiences together.
dates.where: The Front Climbing Club — 1470 S 400 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84115

dates.name: Road Biking — Park City Mountain Trails
dates.desc: Spring is perfect for biking. Scenic Park City trails with valley views, wildflowers, and moderate elevation. Bike shops offer rentals and trail recommendations. Fun, active, and gorgeous scenery.
dates.where: Park City, UT (30 min from SLC) — various trail access points

dates.name: Horseback Riding at Sundance — Mountain Trail Ride
dates.desc: Guided horseback rides through Sundance's mountain trails with spring wildflowers and scenic overlooks. Beginner-friendly with experienced guides. Romantic, peaceful, and unforgettable experience on horseback.
dates.where: Sundance Resort — 8841 Alpine Loop Rd, Sundance, UT 84604

dates.name: Utah Symphony — Classical & Film Scores
dates.desc: World-class orchestra performing classical masterworks and film scores. Romantic, sophisticated, and culturally enriching. Check Abravanel Hall schedule for current offerings.
dates.where: Abravanel Hall — 123 W South Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Natural History Museum — Dinosaurs & Geology Exhibits
dates.desc: World-class paleontology and natural history museum with 60,000+ bones and fossils, interactive exhibits, and stunning valley views. Pair with Red Butte Garden for a full afternoon.
dates.where: Natural History Museum of Utah — 301 S 1300 E, Salt Lake City, UT 84112

dates.name: Salt Lake City Art District Gallery Walk
dates.desc: Explore galleries in downtown SLC's arts district. Local artists, contemporary installations, and rotating exhibits. Grab coffee, browse galleries, discuss art together. Educational and engaging.
dates.where: Salt Lake City Arts District — Downtown SLC (various galleries)

dates.name: Escape Room Challenge — Immersive Puzzle Games
dates.desc: 60-minute immersive escape room. Choose themed rooms (Egyptian Tomb, Heist, Zombie, Reactor). Solve puzzles, work together, and race the clock. Great for couples who enjoy problem-solving and teamwork.
dates.where: Getout Games — 202 W 400 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101 (or other locations)

dates.name: Hot Air Balloon Sunrise Flight — Utah Valley
dates.desc: Magical sunrise flight over Utah Valley with stunning aerial views of Wasatch Mountains, wildflowers, and spring landscape. Peaceful, romantic, once-in-a-lifetime experience.
dates.where: Various launch sites in Utah Valley (Provo/Lehi area)

dates.name: Scenic Railroad Journey — Historic Train Ride
dates.desc: Ride historic trains through scenic Utah landscapes. Some routes include dining cars with gourmet meals. Unique, romantic, and nostalgic experience. Perfect for couples seeking something distinctive.
dates.where: Various Utah train tours (check current schedules)
